column1: # QA-R4 category "editing" (spec/04-quality-release.md), hand curated: Backspace sequences, editing after
# ", ", ". ", double space and newline, tone changes on a finished word, removing marks with z / 0
# (spec/01-engine.md sections 7.4 and 10). Resources: the 13.9 fixtures. One case per line.
# Columns: id, method, options (- or flags, see QACorpusCase), keys, expected (the whole text field after
# the keys), restore (the field after one more restore toggle, - when not checked), note.
# Keys: TSV escapes \s space, \n Return, \t Tab; markers ⌫ Backspace, ⎋ restore toggle, ⟲ reset,
# Newline: Return clears the history (ENG-R912), so the word before a newline is not re-opened; QA-R4's
# "previous word edit context must be recoverable" holds for ", ", ". " and double spaces.
